```{r}
# verify data types, number of unique values, and missing values

data_summary <- data.frame(
  column = names(potholes),
  data_type = sapply(potholes, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  unique_values = sapply(potholes, 
                         function(x) n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  missing_values = sapply(potholes, 
                          function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  missing_percentage = sapply(potholes, 
                              function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
)

data_summary %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "column") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Data Quality Summary",
    subtitle = "Data types, unique values and missing observations"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    data_type = "Data Type",
    unique_values = "Unique Values",
    missing_values = "Missing Values",
    missing_percentage = "Missing (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(unique_values, missing_values),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    palette = c("white", "#F4A6A6")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}

# Columns to remove
removed <- c(
  "service_request_id",
  "service_request_parent_id",
  "sap_notification_number",
  "service_name",
  "service_name_detail",
  "lat",
  "lng",
  "street_address",
  "zipcode",
  "park_name",
  "referred",
  "iamfloc",
  "floc",
  "public_description"
)

# Columns used to identify incomplete observations
missing <- c(
  "comm_plan_code",
  "comm_plan_name",
  "council_district"
)

# Check zipcode-to-council-district relationship
zipcode_check <- potholes %>%
  distinct(zipcode, council_district) %>%
  count(zipcode) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# Create lookup table, retaining only unambiguous matches
district_lookup <- potholes %>%
  filter(!is.na(zipcode), !is.na(council_district)) %>%
  distinct(zipcode, council_district) %>%
  group_by(zipcode) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Clean and impute data
potholes2 <- potholes |>
  mutate(
    date_closed = coalesce(
      date_closed,
      date_requested + days(case_age_days)
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    district_lookup,
    by = "zipcode",
    suffix = c("", "_lookup")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    council_district = coalesce(
      council_district,
      council_district_lookup
    )
  ) |>
  select(-council_district_lookup) |>
  select(-all_of(removed)) |>
  filter(if_all(all_of(missing), ~ !is.na(.x)))

# Check observations removed
cat("Original observations:", original_n, "\n")
cat("Final observations:", nrow(potholes2), "\n")
cat("Observations removed:", original_n - nrow(potholes2), "\n")

# Create data quality summary
data_summary2 <- data.frame(
  column = names(potholes2),
  data_type = sapply(potholes2, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  unique_values = sapply(potholes2,
                         function(x) n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  missing_values = sapply(potholes2,
                          function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  missing_percentage = sapply(potholes2,
                               function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
)

# Display summary table
data_summary2 %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "column") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Data Quality Summary After Cleaning",
    subtitle = "Data types, unique values and missing observations"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    data_type = "Data Type",
    unique_values = "Unique Values",
    missing_values = "Missing Values",
    missing_percentage = "Missing (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(unique_values, missing_values),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    palette = c("white", "#F4A6A6")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE
  )

```

```{r}
# convert datetime data in date_requested and date_closed columns to date only

potholes3 <- potholes2 |>
  mutate(
    date_requested = as.Date(date_requested),
    date_closed = as.Date(date_closed)
  )

# create tsibbles of potholes3 indexed on date_requested and date_closed and aggregate the counts of tickets requested or closed each day

req_ts <- potholes3 |>
  count(date_requested, name = "requests") %>%
  as_tsibble(index = date_requested)

cls_ts <- potholes3 |>
  count(date_closed, name = "closed") %>%
  as_tsibble(index = date_closed)
```

```{r}
# view plot of requests over time

req_ts %>%
  autoplot(requests) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Pothole Requests",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# view plot of closed cases over time

cls_ts %>%
  autoplot(closed) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Pothole Requests Closed",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests Closed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# aggregate cases opened based on month

monreq_ts <- potholes3 %>%
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date_requested)) %>%
  count(month, name = "requests") %>%
  as_tsibble(index = month)

monreq_ts %>%
  autoplot(requests) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Pothole Requests",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# aggregate cases closed based on month

moncls_ts <- potholes3 %>%
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date_closed)) %>%
  count(month, name = "closed") %>%
  as_tsibble(index = month)

moncls_ts %>%
  autoplot(closed) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Pothole Requests Closed",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests Closed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
